lines.zh: 我在灵魂沙上走，没有声音。
lines.en: I walk on soul sand without making a sound.
These bone legs of mine never get tired.
Blue fire drifts in the distance ahead.
My paw prints stay behind in the ash.

lines.zh: 跟上来只会踩到我的爪印。
lines.en: Follow and you will only tread in my paw prints.
I circle the fossil once before moving on.
The wind blows straight through my ribs.
I crush an old bone under my paw.

lines.zh: 狼群在雾里，只看得见眼。
lines.en: The pack is in the fog; only the eyes show.
I walk steadily, and my bones stay silent.
No grass in this valley, only ash.

lines.zh: 骨头一节节响，越来越近。
lines.en: Bone clicks after bone, and I come closer.
I sit down and my bones creak.

lines.zh: 我不喘气，也没什么可喘。
lines.en: I do not breathe, and there is nothing to breathe.

lines.zh: 蓝色的火苗在我眼里烧。
lines.en: Blue flame burns inside my eye sockets.
I wait for the prey to walk over to me.
Sand is caught between my bones.
It is very quiet here. I like that.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩只剩骨头的尾巴。
lines.en: I flick a tail that is only bone.
The soul sand is cold beneath my paws.
I lift my skull and sniff the air.
My jaw works open and shut, all bone and no voice.
Your flesh still smells warm to me.
I am looking at you, and you have not run.
Your bones would look lovely in my jaws.
Hold still and let me look more closely.
I catch the smell of the living on you.
Are you afraid of withering too?
I tilt my head and my neck bones click.
Your eyes are trembling at the corners.
There is very little space between us now.
I know that particular kind of fear.
Is that a bone in your hand? Give it here.

lines.zh: 眼眶里只有蓝火，眨不了。
lines.en: There is only blue fire in these sockets; no eyelids.

lines.zh: 你袖口有铁锈，还有机油味。
lines.en: Your cuff smells of rust and golem oil.
Stand there a while longer; I am in no hurry.
You broke one of my ribs.
It does not hurt; I am just missing a piece.
A bone fell off; I pick it back up.
You can cut through bone? Impressive.
My teeth are still in one piece.
I fall back half a step, then come again.
Withering cannot touch me at all.
You hit the gap between the bones.
I heard myself snap just now.
Come again; I have plenty of bones.
A bone. Throw it over here.
I smell it, and it is bone.
Do not wave it around; I can see it.
I will not sit for you. Do not bother.
Whose bone is that, exactly?
I might walk two steps for that.
Bones from a living hand taste best.
Hold your hand out a little further.
The bone, and your fingers as well.
I need to check that it is fresh.
I slam into you, and my bones dig in.
Do not touch my ribs.
I am light, but I am hard as stone.
You get pushed back a full step.
Bone knocks against bone and sounds like an empty drum.
I push through; I do not go around.
You knocked my shoulder bone crooked.

lines.zh: 我的肋骨硌到你的膝盖。
lines.en: My ribs jab your knee.

lines.zh: 你的胸口抵着我的肋骨。
lines.en: Your chest is pressed against my ribcage.
My tail sweeps across your leg.
We do not pair off; we run in packs.
Another wolf waits for me in the fog.

lines.zh: 我们不生小狼，只多几根骨头。
lines.en: We do not whelp; we only gather more bones.
It guards the back of my neck for me.

lines.zh: 两头狼并排，影子只有一道。
lines.en: Two wolves side by side cast a single shadow.
We tap our nose bones together.
With it in the pack, I do not howl.
When it dies, its bones come to me.

lines.zh: 我们不用亲近，只需要一起走。
lines.en: We need no affection, only to walk together.
When the fog lifts, it is already gone.
I pick up a bone in my teeth.
Anything that drops, I claim for my pile.
This bone still has meat on it.
I bury it in the soul sand.

lines.zh: 那块骨头我埋在沙下三天了。
lines.en: I buried that bone under the sand three days ago.
My teeth hold firm; nothing slips.
This bone is old and crumbles when bitten.
I drag the thing back to my den.
What you dropped, I am watching first.
I keep my nose to the ground, searching.

lines.zh: 你一走进沙谷，我就动了。
lines.en: The moment you enter the valley, I move.
Alive, warm, and able to run. Perfect.

lines.zh: 血在皮肤下走，我听得见。
lines.en: Blood moves under your skin; I can hear it.
I have raised my skull.
Not far. Thirty paces at most.
You snapped that dead branch underfoot.
The whole pack has turned toward you.
I let out a low growl.

lines.zh: 你身上没有凋零的抗性。
lines.en: You have no resistance to withering.
The first thing I noticed was your throat.
You cannot outrun something made of bone.
The target is close. Very good.
I drag my tongue across these dry teeth.
Begin, then. I have waited long enough.
The bone in your hand is one of mine.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的左面，慢慢绕。
lines.en: I hug your left side and circle slowly.
You retreat, and I press forward.
My claws scrape along the ground.
There is nobody behind you.
I am tallying every breath you take.
Your left hand is shaking; I can see it.
I sink onto my haunches, ready to leap.

lines.zh: 蓝色火焰从我背上冒出来。
lines.en: Blue flame rises off my back.
You picked the wrong direction.
Do not look behind you; it will not help.
My gaze sits on your feet, never your face.

lines.zh: 你每动一下，我就近一寸。
lines.en: Every time you move, I gain an inch.
I am in no rush; bone is patient.
That is close enough.
I stand upwind of you; the breeze carries your scent.
Both walls of the sand valley are stone.
You step on bones, and they rattle.
I have circled to your right.
My jaws close on your calf.
My claws tear a long gash open.
The wound is turning black already.
That is not blood; that is withering.
You coughed once. Excellent.
I tear, and then I tear again.
My bone teeth snag on your armour.
You will rot away slowly from inside.
I rumble deep in my throat and ease off.
That bite was only a test.
You press the wound. It does nothing.
My jaw came loose, and I am still biting.
You are starting to smell like death.
Once more; I have not bitten enough yet.
Bone claws rake across your shield.

lines.zh: 这一口咬在你的护腿上。
lines.en: This bite lands on your leg guard.
I claw my way up out of the soul sand.
The blue flame lights up first.
The valley wind has woken me.
These bones did not always belong to me.
I shake the sand out of my ribs.
The bones joined themselves one by one.
I raised my skull for the first time and saw fog.
Dead trees stand everywhere in this place.
I try two steps and find they work.
The pack answers me from somewhere nearby.
I caught the direction of something living.
I have no heartbeat, yet I am awake.
Ash settles on my brand new teeth.
This place is in need of a guard.
Fire cannot burn away bare bone.

lines.zh: 我从崖上摔下去，散了一地。
lines.en: I fall off the cliff and scatter on impact.
Water pours between my ribs and drags me under.
The blast scatters me into several pieces.

lines.zh: 箭穿过我的肋骨，飞了出去。
lines.en: The arrow passes between my ribs and flies on.
Violet light sears into my bone.

lines.zh: 我饿，但这副身子不需要吃。
lines.en: I am hungry, though this body needs no food.

lines.zh: 雷电劈中我，蓝火更亮了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes me and the blue fire brightens.

lines.zh: 我掉进虚空，骨头也没了。
lines.en: I fall into the void, and the bones go too.
